events.title: Multiplayer update 2
events.summary: Combat feel update Punches lock on to the nearest opponent in front of you and step in to make contact. New punch animation and hit effect. Hits now have a short pause, a flinch, knockback, camera shake and rumble. Online, your punch starts the moment you press the button. Online and menus Friends who join a match in progress play their own character and items instead of taking over the bot. Rejoining a match you left keeps your loadout, and your items aren't used up again. Character select: Inv
